dish: house-roasted Arabiya blend coffee (beans roasted in-house each morning) with a kissaten sandwich
n: Arabiya Coffee (アラビヤコーヒー, Namba)
w: Namba kissaten opened in 1951 a few steps from Hōzen-ji, now run by the second-generation master; a Tabelog Kissaten Hyakumeiten pick (2022) featured in Osaka Metro's OsakaMania jun-kissa series.

dish: tori-katsuo shio ramen (chicken & bonito salt ramen), plus chicken-broth tsukemen
n: Men no Yōji (麺のようじ, Kōzu)
address: 2-1-2 Kōzu, Chūō-ku, Osaka (walk from Nipponbashi Station)
w: Eight-seat chicken-and-vegetable-broth ramen counter near Nipponbashi; a Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025 pick, and logged by Ramen Beast.

dish: omakase tonkatsu: several pork cuts in sequence (three at lunch, six at dinner)
n: Tonkatsu Kōshirō (とんかつ 康四郎, Shinsaibashi)
w: Omakase-style tonkatsu counter in Shinsaibashi serving a progression of pork cuts; a Time Out Osaka must-go and a Tabelog Tonkatsu Hyakumeiten pick.

dish: takoyaki, incl. the takoyaki-and-cheese creative variations
address: 1-2-3 Namba, Chūō-ku, Osaka (between Namba and Nipponbashi stations)
w: Dōtonbori takoyaki stand on Time Out Osaka's best-takoyaki list (it held a Michelin Bib Gourmand 2016–18, since lapsed); Mapple's Osaka takoyaki 16 picks it for its takoyaki × cheese menu.

dish: tonkotsu-gyokai tsukemen (pork & dried-fish soup of saba-, sanma-, katsuobushi and urume, about five days in the making) with thick house-made noodles
n: Ikareta Noodle Fishtons (いかれたヌードル フィッシュトンズ)
address: 1-25-18 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka (Renajia Shinmachi Bldg 1F; near Nishi-Ōhashi Station)
w: Back-alley tsukemen specialist near Nishi-Ōhashi; a Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten pick (2023, 2024) with a Ramen Adventures write-up of its heavy tonkotsu-gyokai dip.
